paper_role: bounded task-treatment selection; no richer-factor loss

cohorts.aggregate: macro-average NR and TSR after task-specific reporting

configurations.adapter: three independent task-private residual bottlenecks; no shared trainable adapter

configurations.task_input: canonical three-way one-hot concatenated only at the adapter bottleneck
hard routing of task-private residual; shared residual always active
configurations.adapter: one shared plus three hard-masked task-private residual bottlenecks

training.batch_task_policy: task-homogeneous batches on an identical frozen task schedule for all configurations
training.duplicate_text_policy: no normalized text identity may appear twice in one batch
training.validation_checkpoint_rule: highest macro NR/TSR MRR; earliest epoch breaks ties

task_controls.masked_generic: unchanged because generic receives no task
task_controls.masked_separate: mean prediction across all three private adapters
task_controls.shuffled: fixed cyclic map SR->NR, NR->TSR, TSR->SR

continuation_rule.task_aware_winner: masked_shared_private must improve primary macro MRR over both generic_pooled and task_token with positive paired clustered lower bound and non-decreasing signal gap
continuation_rule.richer_stage: only the winning masked_shared_private model may add the admitted TSR instruction-relation head
